instruction: Please help me change the color theme of VS Code to Kimbie Dark.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "workbench.colorTheme" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"workbench.colorTheme": "[^"]*"/"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code color theme from 'Red' to 'Kimbie Dark'. Evaluator checks if settings.json contains the correct theme value. Uses existing compare_config metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'check_json_settings' metric which parses JSON and checks for specific key-value pairs
Getter correctly fetches VS Code settings.json file from VM using get_vm_file
Expected value is semantically correct: checks for 'workbench.colorTheme': 'Kimbie Dark' key-value pair
Metric allows other settings in the file - only verifies that the specific theme key has the correct value
Complete coverage: instruction asks to change theme, evaluator verifies theme setting

Expected parameter handling is correct: when type='rule', get_rule returns config['rules'], so metric receives {'expected': {'workbench.colorTheme': 'Kimbie Dark'}} and correctly accesses expected['expected']

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
